name: router
description: Classify a query into a tier (e.g. light | standard | deep) to pick which model answers it: fast deterministic rules first (length, keywords, context), then an optional injected LLM classifier, then a safe default. Fail-safe — a classifier that errors or returns an unknown tier falls through to the default. Provider-free core; an AI SDK classifier adapter is included.

adapters.name: ai-classifier
adapters.desc: Build a Classifier from an AI SDK model (ask a cheap model to label the query with a tier). Requires the `ai` peer dep.
